macos.notes: One entry per OAuth app that signed in, keyed 'github.com:<client id>'. The older hosts.json keys entries by host only. Only the key github.com or github.com:<client id> is read: a bare prefix would also match an Enterprise host such as github.company.com. Several github.com entries may hold tokens for different accounts - one editor signed in as each - and the file names no active one, so unless every token-bearing entry agrees on user the file is skipped entirely and hosts.yml, which does name the active account, answers. $XDG_CONFIG_HOME moves the directory. As a last resort the GitHub CLI token in ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml is tried; it may lack Copilot scope. $GH_CONFIG_DIR, then $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/gh, moves that file, in the order gh documents. Only the top-level github.com block's own oauth_token is read, which is the active account's: an Enterprise host's token, or another account's under users:, never reaches api.github.com. A file that is there but cannot be read is credentialExpired, not needsAuth.

windows.notes: Same shape and rules; hosts.json alongside; the GitHub CLI token lives in %APPDATA%/GitHub CLI/hosts.yml. $XDG_CONFIG_HOME, when set, comes first for both: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/github-copilot and $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/gh, with $GH_CONFIG_DIR ahead of it for gh.

linux.notes: The C# was Windows-only from birth and produced ~/.local/share/github-copilot/apps.json and '~/.config/GitHub CLI/hosts.yml' on Linux, both wrong. Copilot CLI follows the XDG base directory specification here: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/github-copilot/apps.json, ~/.config when that is unset, with the gh CLI's own token in $GH_CONFIG_DIR, then $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/gh, then ~/.config/gh. Otherwise the macOS block applies unchanged.

endpoints.name: usage
endpoints.notes: GitHub answers an exhausted rate limit with 403 as often as with 429. A 403 carrying x-ratelimit-remaining: 0 or Retry-After is rateLimited, backing off exponentially like a 429; any other 403 means the account has no Copilot seat.

windows.label: Premium requests
windows.notes: usedFraction = 1 - percent_remaining / 100, clamped to [0, 1]. A snapshot with unlimited=true is not a window. remaining=0 with overage_permitted=false is a hard limit.

windows.label: Chat
windows.notes: Only metered on the Free plan.

windows.label: Completions
windows.notes: Only metered on the Free plan.

sessions.notes: Copilot's agents leave no readable trace on disk; usage only.

status.notice: Uses the GitHub OAuth token the Copilot plugin stores; the endpoint is the one the editor status bar reads. A 403 means the account has no Copilot seat, unless it carries GitHub's rate-limit headers.
